---
description: Run the shared evidence-backed application-understanding workflow
---

Use the shared CLI described in [the command guide](../../docs/agents/commands/understand-application.md). Prepare evidence, reason only over the generated packages as the active Copilot agent, produce the schema-valid submission, and invoke deterministic validation. Require approved KG readiness, retain unresolved backend mappings, and do not create features, stories, architecture, or Angular output. Do not request an external LLM API key for this interactive workflow.
